newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease in quiet trade, trend unclear.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease in quiet trade, trend unclear.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased in calm Monday trading, but dealers said the further trend was difficult to forecast as the buying mood of some operators was counterbalanced by approaching year-end holidays.
"The day was less active compared with what we saw last week. Prices have not changed much since morning," one dealer said.
Dealers found it difficult to predict further market moves in the absence of fresh market-moving factors after Russia's Eurobond issue and partial resolution of bond freeze problem.
"Some banks consider MinFins cheap compared with other Russian paper, some want to see higher levels to close earlier positions," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said.
But he added some other operators were seen selling to come out of bonds ahead of the year-end.
